Product Roadmap for "KidHero Health" (or "GrowHero Kids" â€“ suggest a catchy, positive name)
Phase 1: MVP (Months 1-4) â€“ Core Health Tracking & Camp Integration
Focus on essential features for school camps, basic tracking, parent dashboard, and doctor/hospital partnerships.
Key Features:

Onboarding & Auth: Parent registration (phone/email + OTP), kid profile creation (name, age, gender, school, basic metrics).
Parent Dashboard: Overview of all kids' health stats, recent camp results, alerts.
Camp Module: School camp scheduling, results upload (growth charts, dental/eye/growth flags) by doctors/camp admins.
Health Records: BMI/growth tracking, dental/eye issues logging, basic reports.
Diet Suggestions: Basic dietician input or templates; personalized suggestions per kid.
Hero Badges: Simple reward system for compliance/improvement (tracked via follow-ups or self-reports).
Appointment Booking: Integration with partner hospitals/doctors for follow-ups.
Notifications: Reminders for camps, checkups, diet adherence.

Tech Stack Suggestion: Flutter/React Native for cross-platform (iOS/Android), Firebase/Auth0 for auth & backend, Supabase or custom backend for data, Stripe/Razorpay for any payments.
Success Metrics: 10+ schools onboarded, 500+ kids tracked, 80% parent retention after first camp.
Team Needs: 1-2 mobile devs, 1 backend, 1 designer, 1 product/ops for school & hospital outreach.
Phase 2: Engagement & Personalization (Months 5-8)

AI Video Creator: Generate short explanatory videos on diets (personalized with kid's name, preferences, local foods).
Advanced Tracking: Daily/weekly logs (weight, meals, activity), progress charts, gamification (badges, streaks, leaderboards in schools).
Parent Tools: Multi-child view, family sharing, educational content library.
Doctor Portal: Web dashboard for doctors to upload camp data, suggest diets, view anonymized trends.
School Admin Features: Bulk kid registration, camp management.

Enhancements: Push notifications, basic analytics, offline support for logs.
Phase 3: Scale & Advanced Features (Months 9-18)

AI Enhancements: Predictive growth insights, personalized meal plans with image recognition for food logging, voice input.
Community & Social: Parent forums, school challenges, anonymized success stories.
Integrations: Wearables (basic kid-friendly), government health schemes (if in India), telemedicine.
Monetization: Premium parent subscriptions (advanced AI, ad-free), B2B school/hospital licensing, sponsored healthy food partnerships.
Compliance: Strong data privacy (GDPR-like for kids' health data in India â€“ IT Act, DPDP), parental consent flows.

Expansion: Multi-language (English + regional like Telugu/Hindi), rural school adaptations.
Long-term Vision (Year 2+): Nationwide coverage in India, exportable model, integration with Ayushman Bharat or school health programs, full AI diagnostic support (with doctor oversight).
Risks & Considerations:

Data privacy & medical accuracy (always "for informational purposes, consult doctor").
School/hospital adoption (start with pilots in Hyderabad/Telangana).
Content moderation for AI videos.
Funding: Bootstrap or seek healthtech grants/impact investors.

Prioritization Framework: Use MoSCoW (Must-have, Should-have, Could-have, Won't-have) per phase. Validate with parent/teacher interviews.

Prompts for Building Screens in Stitch (stitch.withgoogle.com)
Stitch excels at generating mobile app UIs from natural language prompts. Start with a consistent style: Modern, colorful, playful yet trustworthy â€“ use bright greens/blues, kid-friendly icons (cartoon heroes, healthy foods), clean sans-serif fonts, ample white space. Target Mobile App (iOS/Android style). Specify "bottom navigation bar with Home, Kids, Camps, Rewards, Profile".
General Style Prompt Prefix (add to most prompts):
"Create a vibrant, modern mobile app screen for a kids health tracking app called KidHero. Use a playful yet professional design with bright colors (greens, blues, yellow accents), cartoon hero icons, rounded corners, clean typography. Mobile iOS/Android style with safe areas."
1. Onboarding Screens
Onboarding 1 â€“ Welcome/Splash:
"Generate the first onboarding screen for KidHero kids health app. Hero image of happy diverse kids with superhero capes running in a park, healthy food and medical icons. Big title 'Track Your Kid's Growth Heroically!', subtitle 'School camps, diet plans, doctor support & rewards'. Bright 'Get Started' button at bottom. Skip option."
Onboarding 2-3 (Carousel):
"Next onboarding slide: Illustration of school medical camp with doctor checking kid height/weight/eyes/teeth. Title 'Free School Health Camps', description 'Identify growth, dental, eye issues early'."
"Third slide: Family dashboard mockup with multiple kids cards showing health stats. Title 'All Your Kids in One Place', description 'Personalized diet, progress tracking & hero badges'."
Onboarding 4 â€“ Permissions/Intro:
"Final onboarding: Benefits summary with icons for AI videos, appointments, badges. Prominent 'Create Account' button."
2. Authentication Screens
Login/Signup:
"Mobile auth screen for KidHero app. Top logo and name. Tabs for Login and Sign Up. Phone number input with country code (India focus), OTP verification hint. Google/Apple sign-in buttons. Trust badges for secure & private. Background with subtle healthy kids pattern."
OTP Verification:
"Clean OTP entry screen. 'Enter verification code sent to +91 XXXXXXX'. 6-digit input fields, resend timer. Big Verify button."
Kid Profile Creation (Multi-step):
"Form screen to add a child: Photo upload circle, fields for Name, Age, Gender, School/Class, Height/Weight. Next button. Fun illustrations."
3. Core App Screens (Post-Onboarding)
Home/Dashboard (Parent View):
"Parent home dashboard for KidHero. Top greeting 'Hi Priya, Good Morning!', quick stats cards for 2-3 kids (e.g., 'Rahul - Growth on track 92%', progress rings). Recent camp results section. Upcoming appointments. Bottom nav: Home, My Kids, Camps, Rewards, More. Hero banner promoting next school camp."
My Kids List:
"Screen showing all children as colorful cards. Each card: Photo, name, age, key metrics (BMI, last checkup). Tap to view details. Floating + button to add kid."
Individual Kid Profile/Health Stats:
"Detailed kid profile: Header with photo & name. Tabs: Overview (growth chart), Dental, Eyesight, Nutrition. Line/area charts for height/weight. Issue flags (green/yellow/red). Diet recommendations section."
Diet & AI Videos:
"Personalized diet plan screen. Daily meal suggestions with Indian foods (dal, rice, veggies). 'Generate AI Video' button explaining benefits. Video thumbnail previews. Track 'I ate this' checkboxes for badges."
Camps & Bookings:
"School camps list or calendar. Past/upcoming camps with results. 'Book Follow-up' button linking to hospital partners. Doctor availability slots."
Rewards/Hero Badges:
"Fun rewards screen: Grid of earned badges (Super Eater, Growth Champion) with descriptions and progress towards next. Leaderboard for school/class (anonymized)."
Profile & Settings:
"Parent profile: Family info, linked kids, notification preferences, linked hospitals, logout."
Additional Important Screens:

Camp Results Upload (Doctor view â€“ simpler web or in-app).
Appointment Booking Flow (List doctors/hospitals â†’ Select slot â†’ Confirmation).
Notifications Center.
Progress Reports (PDF shareable).


Use Host Grotesk font with very professional UI, Please generate high quality images for onboarding screens. Must be very clean and professional. use linear icons instead of emojis.

Use MyHealth by HealthSetGo as reference.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hsg.health.android
